bio.text: Michael "Dr. Mike" Katz is the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Delaware in 2026.

According to his campaign website, he is a physician and pediatric critical-care anesthesiologist who came to Delaware in 1996 to work at A.I. duPont Hospital for Children, and holds a medical degree and an MBA from Georgetown University.
His campaign site says he served in the Delaware State Senate from 2009 to 2013 as a Democrat, and ran for U.S. Senate in 2024 as an Independent.
